explanation: Bill Anders took it on 24 December 1968, as the first crew to orbit the Moon swung round from its far side. Apollo 11's landing came seven months later.

claims.text: The photograph Earthrise was taken during the Apollo 8 mission in December 1968.
Earthrise was not taken on Apollo 11 (1969), Apollo 13 (1970) or Apollo 17 (1972).
Astronaut Bill Anders took the Earthrise photograph on 24 December 1968.
Apollo 8's crew were the first people to orbit the Moon.
Apollo 11 landed on the Moon in July 1969, seven months after Apollo 8's Earthrise.
